title: Complementary differential basis data
statement: theorem exists_smoothAtPrime_differential_data (R : Type u) [CommRing R] (n m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R) (V : Finset (Fin m)) (c : ℕ) (q : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))) (ha : Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a ∉ q.asIdeal) (_hcard : V.card = c) (hbound : c ≤ min n m) (hsm : Algebra.Smooth R (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a))) : (∃ (e : Fin c ≃ V), ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin c) (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a)) (LocalizedModule.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a) (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent), ∀ j : Fin c, b j = LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a)) (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent ((Ideal.span (Set.range f)).toCotangent ⟨f (e j).1, Ideal.subset_span ⟨(e j).1, rfl⟩⟩)) → ∃ a' : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R, Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a' ∉ q.asIdeal ∧ Algebra.Smooth R (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a')) ∧ (∃ (e : Fin c ≃ V), ∃ b : Module.Basis (Fin c) (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a')) (LocalizedModule.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a') (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent), ∀ j : Fin c, b j = LocalizedModule.mkLinearMap (Submonoid.powers (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a')) (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent ((Ideal.span (Set.range f)).toCotangent ⟨f (e j).1, Ideal.subset_span ⟨(e j).1, rfl⟩⟩)) ∧ Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin (n - c)) (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a')) (KaehlerDifferential R (Localization.Away (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) a'))))

proof.text: Apply the split conormal sequence on the initial smooth principal open. Spread the finite projective differential complement of rank n-c to a smaller principal open, then base change the prescribed conormal basis to that same open. Lift the additional localization factor from the quotient to the polynomial ring and use primality to keep the product outside q.
